world_regions.purpose: Offline country-outline world map colored by coarse report aggregation buckets.
world_regions.source_reference: Natural Earth public-domain 1:110m Admin 0 country vectors, retrieved from the Natural Earth vector GitHub mirror during visual repair.
world_regions.license_note: Natural Earth vector and raster map data are public domain.
world_regions.normalization: Country features keep lightweight names and ISO codes, Antarctica is excluded, and each feature is assigned to one report_region: North America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, Asia outside China, or China. Taiwan is displayed as Taiwan Province and mapped to China for this report visualization.
world_regions.report_caveat: The map is a country-outline reader visualization for coarse report regions, not a political boundary authority.

china_provinces.purpose: Offline China province map for ECharts rendering.
china_provinces.source_reference: GeoJSON.cn TianDiTu national standard vector atlas API, endpoint https://geojson.cn/api/tiandi/100000.json, retrieved during report implementation.
china_provinces.official_reference: Natural Resources Ministry standard map service is used as the official cartographic reference basis for report caveats.
china_provinces.coordinate_system: CGCS2000 / EPSG:4490 as documented by GeoJSON.cn for the TianDiTu atlas.
china_provinces.normalization: Feature properties are rewritten to English report labels; Taiwan Province is retained as a province-level label.
china_provinces.report_caveat: The interactive province layer is for report visualization and must be read with the source and standard map caveats.
